description: This file contains tests for event bus subscription, unsubscription, publishing, and serialization functions within the 'events' package. It verifies functionality of event channels, message dispatch, multi-subscriber handling, and JSON serialization for different event types related to execution, nodes, and reasoners.

methods.name: TestExecutionEventBus_Subscribe
methods.description: Tests subscription to the execution event bus.

methods.name: TestExecutionEventBus_Unsubscribe
methods.description: Tests unsubscription from the execution event bus.

methods.name: TestExecutionEventBus_Publish
methods.description: Tests publishing events on the execution event bus and receiving them.

methods.name: TestExecutionEventBus_MultipleSubscribers
methods.description: Verifies multiple subscribers receive published events.

methods.name: TestExecutionEventBus_ConcurrentPublish
methods.description: Tests concurrent publishing of events and their reception.

methods.name: TestNodeEventBus_Subscribe
methods.description: Tests subscription to the node event bus.

methods.name: TestNodeEventBus_Publish
methods.description: Tests publishing node events and reception.

methods.name: TestReasonerEventBus_Subscribe
methods.description: Tests subscription to the reasoner event bus.

methods.name: TestReasonerEventBus_Publish
methods.description: Tests publishing reasoner events and reception.

methods.name: TestExecutionEvent_ToJSON
methods.description: Verifies JSON serialization of an execution event.

methods.name: TestNodeEvent_ToJSON
methods.description: Verifies JSON serialization of a node event.

methods.name: TestReasonerEvent_ToJSON
methods.description: Verifies JSON serialization of a reasoner event.

methods.name: TestGlobalEventBuses
methods.description: Verifies global instances of event buses are accessible and functional.
